fe74ebe2-bd22-454c-bd51-783a4e7a50cf@ufc.why: Former light heavyweight champ Jiri Prochazka (#2), rebounding from a title-fight KO loss to Carlos Ulberg, meets unbeaten #5 Navajo Stirling, who just finished ex-champ Jan Blachowicz; the winner edges closer to a title shot. Co-main: former bantamweight champ Aljamain Sterling (#4 featherweight) faces surging prospect Kevin Vallejos (#9); a Vallejos win would push him into title contention.
fe74ebe2-bd22-454c-bd51-783a4e7a50cf@ufc.know: UFC rankings run from champion down through #1-15 in each weight class, so beating a higher-ranked foe boosts your title case. A Fight Night card has no championship bout but is where rising fighters, like first-time headliner Stirling, try to prove they belong among the elite.

afce88a5-30fa-41f5-be6d-38cadb4fe552@nin.why: San Francisco is 8-1, the best mark in the NFC West, while Minnesota is 7-2 and one of the stronger teams in the conference. The Vikings (7-2) wrapped their practice week Friday ahead of meeting the 49ers (8-1) in Mexico for their Week 11 game on Sunday Night Football. A win pads the Niners' division lead and playoff positioning; a loss is just their second all year and wouldn't cost them first place, so nothing clinches or ends here yet.
afce88a5-30fa-41f5-be6d-38cadb4fe552@nin.know: NFC West is the four-team division the 49ers play in; leading it now matters for seeding later. Sunday Night Football is one of the league's prime-time showcase slots for marquee games. Minnesota just shook up its offense: Kyler Murray (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the 49ers, and the quarterback lost his job to Kirk Cousins, so watch how the new starter performs against San Francisco's defense.
